name: Acid line
why: A plain saw through a resonant filter that is pushed until it squeals. The notes matter less than how the filter moves.
pattern: note("a1 a1 a2 a1 c2 a1 e2 g1").fast(2)

ingredients.name: One sawtooth
ingredients.adds: A buzzy bass note with nothing done to it.

ingredients.name: Ladder filter
ingredients.adds: Cuts the top off so there is room to open it later.
ingredients.listenFor: The buzz turns into a round thud.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.above: Already open, so the envelope has nowhere to go.

ingredients.name: Resonance
ingredients.adds: A whistling peak at the cutoff. This is the acid.
ingredients.listenFor: A vowel-like squelch on each note.

ingredients.name: Filter envelope
ingredients.adds: The filter snaps open on each note and falls shut.

knobs.label: env depth
knobs.above: Every note is a harsh chirp.

ingredients.name: Drive
ingredients.adds: Grit that makes the resonance scream.

pitfalls: High resonance with the cutoff too low gives a whistle and no bass.
